_comment: Moons as a middle ground for expansion: orbital craft land outposts on moons (home moons in Earthfall, any charted world's moons in Sunreach). Logic in src/loop/cosmos.ts.

techs.name: Orbital Craft
techs.desc: Reusable landers that can reach your moons. Send one from the star-system map to land an outpost on a moon.

techs.name: Lunar Industry
techs.desc: +50% output from moon outposts, and outposts can grow to level 3.
